q2_0: one warp (32 threads) per output neuron
lane l handles elements l, l+32, l+64, ... across K blocks
q4k_v2: lane 0 broadcasts d, dmin via shfl.sync.idx.b32 (2 per block)
lanes 0-3 load packed scales, broadcast 8 values via shfl (8 per block)
4 j-groups fully unrolled, 2 nibble pairs per group per lane
PTX: 8 shfl scale broadcasts + 2 d/dmin broadcasts per K block
q6k_v2: lane 0 broadcasts d via shfl (d same across 256 elements per block)
8-step per block fully unrolled for ILP
